Physics 2010-II.question: Which one of the following statement is true?
options: Temperatures differing 25° on the fahrenheit (F) scale must differ by 45° on the celsius (C) scale

Physics 2010-II.subject: Physics
Physics 2010-II.question: A diffraction pattern is obtained using a beam of  red light. Which one among the following will be the outcome, if the red light is replaced by blue light?
options: Diffraction pattern becomes broader and further apart
Diffraction  pattern  becomes  narrower  and  crowded together
Physics 2010-II.answer: Diffraction  pattern  becomes  narrower  and  crowded together
Physics 2010-II.explanation: (c)  Diffraction pattern becomes narrower and crowded together.

Physics 2010-II.subject: Physics
Physics 2010-II.question: Raw mangoes shrivel when pickled in brine. The phenomenon is associated with
options: increase of surface tension of fluid
decrease of surface tension of fluid
Physics 2010-II.explanation: (a)  Raw mangoes shrivel when pickled in brine due to osmosis i.e. flow of water from higher concentration to lower concentration through a semi-permeable membrane.

Physics 2010-II.question: The apparent weight of a steel sphere immersed in various liquids is measured using a spring balance. The greatest reading is obtained for the liquid
options: in which the sphere was submerged deepest
Physics 2010-II.explanation: (a)  When a body immersed in a liquid, then the apparent weight of the body depends upon the densities of the liquids and volume of the portion of the solid immersed in liquid. So, the apparent weight of a steel sphere will be greatest for the liquid with the smallest density.

Physics 2010-II.subject: Physics
Physics 2010-II.question: The pressure exerted on the ground by a man is greatest
options: when the lies down in the ground
when the stands on the toes of one foot
when the stands with both foot flat on the ground
all of the above yield the same pressure
Physics 2010-II.answer: when the stands on the toes of one foot
Physics 2010-II.explanation: (b)  Pressure is normal force per unit area, therefore, for lesser value of area pressure is greatest.

Physics 2010-II.question: A passenger in a moving train tosses a five rupee coin. If the coin falls behind him, then the train must be moving with a uniform

Physics 2010-II.subject: Physics
Physics 2010-II.question: The force acting on a particle executing simple harmonic motion is
options: directly proportional to the displacement and is directed away from the mean position
inversely proportional to the displacement and is directed towards the mean position
directly proportional to the displacement and is directed towards the mean position
inversely proportional to the displacement and is directed away from the mean position
Physics 2010-II.answer: directly proportional to the displacement and is directed towards the mean position
Physics 2010-II.explanation: (c)  The restoring force acting on the particle is always proportional to the displacement of the particle from the equilibrium position and is always directed towards the equilibrium position.

Physics 2010-II.subject: Physics
Physics 2010-II.question: Which one of the following statements is correct?
options: The angle of contact of water with glass is acute while that of mercury with glass is obtuse
The angle of contact of water with glass is obtuse, while that of mercury with glass is acute
Both the angle of contact of water with glass and that of mercury with glass are acute
Physics 2010-II.answer: The angle of contact of water with glass is acute while that of mercury with glass is obtuse
Physics 2010-II.explanation: (a)  For ordinary water and glass it is about 8° (acute angle) and for mercury and glass it is about 135° (obtuse angle).
